newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kumagai Gumi, others win Vietnam hydro power order.
newsitem.headline: Kumagai Gumi, others win Vietnam hydro power order.

text.p: Kumagai Gumi Co Ltd said on Monday that it and consortium members won an 11 billion yen contract for a hydro electric power project from the Vietnamese government.
The consortium comprises Kukdong Engineering and Construction Co Ltd of South Korea, Astaldi SpA of Italy and Kumagai, the Japanese general contractor said in a statement.
The Ham Thuan Da Mi Hydropower Project will be located about 200 km east of Ho Chi Minh City and is expected to be completed in January 2001, it said.
The project, which will include several dams, will generate 300 megawatts of electricity, it said.
The project will be financed by loans from the Japanese government, it said.
